newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE LIGHT AT $105/DRESSED - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE LIGHT AT $105/DRESSED - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were near steady, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fairly good. Seller interest limited.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs - two pens 65.50; dressed basis 105.00, pen predominately Choice blacks 105.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1150 lbs - pen 65.50; dressed basis 105.00.
For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis mostly 1.00 lower; dressed basis mostly 2.00 lower. The week's total includes 9,000 previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on
